spec_evidence.checked: Cached vercel OAS snapshots v1.28.11 vs v1.28.12, direct schema walk: the connections array property (items: { edgeConfigId, edgeConfigItemKey }, both required) exists in the v1.28.11 feature-flags settings response schemas (GET/PATCH project, GET team) and is absent from every corresponding v1.28.12 schema. No successor field appears in the new schemas.

fix.migration_guide: The connections array (Edge Config links: edgeConfigId, edgeConfigItemKey) was removed from all feature-flags settings response schemas (GET/PATCH /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/settings, GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/settings). Readers now get undefined. The mechanical fix is to remove reads of connections (and its edgeConfigId/edgeConfigItemKey items) from response handling: destructuring, iteration, display logic. There is no replacement field; Edge Config linkage is no longer reported through these endpoints.
fix.example_before:
const { connections } = settings;
for (const c of connections) syncEdgeConfig(c.edgeConfigId, c.edgeConfigItemKey);
fix.example_after: // connections removed from feature-flags settings responses upstream (v1.28.12); read deleted.
